label: MPLS
notes: MPLS label stack entry over the unicast EtherType 0x8847. One 4-byte entry is modelled: the outermost label, the one a GNS3 filter sees at a fixed offset. Deeper entries sit behind a variable label-stack depth and are not modelled. The Traffic Class field was originally the EXP field and was renamed by RFC 5462; the multicast EtherType 0x8848 carries the same 4-byte entry.

fields.label: Label
fields.description: 20-bit label value; 0-15 are reserved (0 explicit null, 1 router alert, 3 implicit null).

fields.label: Traffic Class
fields.ref: RFC 3032 §2.1 (EXP field, renamed Traffic Class by RFC 5462)
fields.description: 3-bit class of service; values 0-7 map to the IP precedence/DCS qdiscs.

fields.label: Bottom of Stack
fields.description: 1 when this entry is the last label in the stack.

fields.label: TTL
fields.description: Hop count, decremented at each label-switch hop like an IP TTL.
